sentences: Worst-case-to-average-case reductions aim to turn the difficulty of some inputs into difficulty on a substantial fraction of a samplable distribution.
The source asks for suitable reductions that remain within NP.
Staying inside NP preserves efficient verification of witnesses while attempting to distribute hardness more broadly.
A successful construction would connect basic worst-case assumptions to the distributional hardness used in pseudorandomness and related areas.
The saved survey note does not preserve the input distribution, reduction type, or hardness fraction, so those parameters must be recovered before the broad direction becomes one exact implication.
